findings.message: This directory has the historical layout created by agentsandbox init: private key sources, their read-only projections, sessions and pending operations.
findings.action: No action is needed. The commands init, up, down, run, worker-status, worker-resume, worker-stop, export-workspace, verify-audit and providers read this layout.

findings.message: The arguments of the gateway and of the dashboard are not stored in the installation: listening addresses, policy file and event bound are not checked.
findings.action: Read them in the command line or the Compose file of the launcher.
findings.requires: the command line or the Compose file of the launcher

findings.message: This tool starts nothing and contacts nothing: whether the gateway, the dashboard or a worker is running is not checked.
findings.action: Ask a running service with agentsandbox healthcheck --url URL.

findings.message: A gateway started without a tenant registry serves one tenant, named local.
findings.action: No action is needed. For several tenants, start the gateway with a tenant registry.

findings.message: Local named accounts and memberships live in the tenant stores, which this build cannot inspect offline.
findings.action: Nothing in this build covers it offline.

findings.message: No OIDC file was given, so single sign-on was not inspected. SSO is optional and is enabled only by a gateway option; a historical config directory alone says nothing about it.
findings.action: Pass --oidc-config FILE or --installation-dir DIR to inspect an OIDC file.

findings.message: This tool opens no file that the inspected files name as a key file, a token file or a credential file. Whether each file holds a well-formed and distinct value is not checked.
findings.action: The consuming command validates the content when it starts.
findings.requires: the consuming command checks the content when it starts

findings.message: This config directory has no providers.json: no managed AI client profile is declared.
findings.action: To declare API profiles, run agentsandbox providers init --config-dir "<config>" --env-file PATH. Subscription profiles are written by hand, as the provider guide describes.

findings.message: The decision engine is selected by gateway options and variables that are not stored in the installation: the selection is not checked. For a backend that calls an engine, the gateway requires its URL and its model, and a key file for the TypeSafe backend; it refuses an incomplete or mixed set of decision-engine options.
findings.action: Read the gateway launcher: the option --jev-backend, then the variable named JEV_BACKEND, then a legacy URL option; with none of them no decision engine is used.
findings.requires: the command line or the Compose file of the launcher

findings.message: This build has no offline inspection of a local model backend: image, weights, memory budget and readiness are not examined.
findings.action: Nothing in this build covers it offline. The local-AI guide describes how to build and verify the backend.

findings.message: This build has no reader for the outputs of model TLS provisioning.
findings.action: Nothing in this build covers it offline.

findings.message: No engine was named, so no engine program was inspected.
This tool never executes the engine: whether it runs, its version and its rootless mode are not checked.
findings.action: Run agentsandbox doctor --runtime docker or agentsandbox doctor --runtime podman; that command executes the engine.
findings.requires: agentsandbox doctor --runtime docker or agentsandbox doctor --runtime podman

findings.message: The store path of a historical config directory is a gateway option that is not stored in the installation: no store was located.
findings.action: Read the gateway launcher: the option --data, or the Compose volume.
findings.requires: the command line or the Compose file of the launcher

findings.message: This diagnostic never opens SQLite connections to tenant stores or authentication audits: schema, tenant binding, audit format and integrity are not examined here. The online command agentsandbox verify-audit --config-dir DIR --gateway URL asks the running gateway for its local hash-chain check and reads the viewer file.
findings.action: For tenant audit evidence, use the signed-checkpoint guide as a separate explicit operation. A gateway local-chain check and independently anchored rollback verification are different operations.

findings.message: Signed tenant checkpoints and independent rollback continuity were not verified by this diagnostic.
findings.action: Use ai-guard-audit-checkpoint verify as a separate, deliberate offline operation with tenant checkpoint evidence and an independently held trust anchor. Follow the signed-checkpoint guide for optional database comparison and its sidecar effects.
findings.requires: explicit ai-guard-audit-checkpoint verify with tenant checkpoint evidence and an independently held trust anchor

limits.message: This build contains no list of qualified client versions.
limits.action: Record the client versions you build into the worker image; this tool cannot confirm them.

limits.message: Whether Codex CLI or Claude Code is present is probed only inside the worker when it starts. This build has no check on the control side.
limits.action: Nothing in this build covers it offline. A launch reports an absent client from the worker.

limits.message: The version of a client is probed only inside the worker when it starts. This build has no check on the control side.
limits.action: Nothing in this build covers it offline. A launch reports an incompatible version from the worker.

limits.message: Whether a provider account or a subscription is valid can only be established by the provider. This tool makes no provider call.
limits.action: Nothing in this build covers it. A launch is the first use of the account.

limits.message: The product accepts one exact signed OIDC profile. Compatibility with a given identity provider is not presumed and is not qualified by this tool.
limits.action: Follow the SSO guide and qualify your identity provider with a real sign-in.

limits.message: This build has no managed internal-inference profile for Codex CLI or Claude Code: a provider profile carries no URL, no format and no CA field.
limits.action: Nothing in this build covers it. The enterprise guide states what is delivered.

limits.message: Worker launch through the Kubernetes adapter is not available in this build; its diagnostics do not enable admission.
limits.action: Use Docker or Podman for workers. To inspect an authority without admitting workers, use agentsandbox kubernetes doctor.

limits.message: This tool looks only inside the directories it is given. A setup staging directory left beside a published installation is not searched for.
limits.action: If a preparation was interrupted, pass the retained staging directory that setup prepare printed as --installation-dir DIR.

limits.message: Private-directory and private-file checks follow the product policy for local Linux and macOS file systems. A network or FUSE file system is refused by that policy, not examined.
limits.action: Keep the installation on a supported local file system.
